text:
Lina: Truck stuck at FRA gateway. Customs reclassification on H100s. AWB 555-77788899. PO RDW-74811. Carrier suggests partial airlift (4 units) + sea for rest. Cost estimate €9.6k. Need quick call: air or clear with customs (~2-4d). :thinking_face:

Marco (AtlasShip): Confirmed. Hold due to commodity description. We can pull 4 SNs for immediate air (ETA ~36h) and ship remaining by sea (~8-11d). Expedited est €9.6k incl broker rush. Lower to €7.2k if you accept PO amendment + next-PO credit.

Raj: Finance prefers the credit option. Is €7.2k firm? Need invoice lines separate: expedited surcharge + carrier fee. Also please ensure expedited SNs are contiguous for asset tagging.

Marco (AtlasShip): Firm €7.2k if amendment signed in 20m. Expedited SNs: H100-EU-2001..2004. Sea: H100-EU-2005..2016. Will attach signed commercial invoice + manifest after amendment.

Devon: Ops request: if we accept air, don't automatic-deploy. Depot QC hold required: photos, serial reconciliation, 20m burn-in, POST. Open provisional RMA for DOA to speed replacements.

ops-bot: Task created: `task-74811-depot-qc` assigned to @Devon. Checklist: inbound photos, serial reconciliation, 20m burn-in, POST, dmesg snapshot.

Marta: Infra note : FRA-1 rack window limited this week. If units arrive in 36h expect ~72h to install + KMS injection. Tag cost center INFRA-GPU.

Lina: Ok team, proceed with amendment at €7.2k. Marco, send proforma + amended PO to procurement@redwood.ai and customs@redwood.ai. Include broker contact and signed invoice PDF.

Marco (AtlasShip): Amendment sent and proforma attached to Lina's email. Pre-creating RMA: RMA-74811-01. Prepaid return labels attached. Carrier will send pickup photos to AWB email.

Devon: Pre-hold check logs from provisioner:
```
$ docker logs gpu-provisioner | tail -n 10
2026-05-04T11:20:03Z provisioner: reconcile ok
2026-05-04T11:20:07Z inventory: inbound 0 -> pending 1
2026-05-04T11:20:11Z health: all clusters nominal
```
No anomalies before hold.

Marta: Thanks. Once carrier pics and manifest are uploaded, ops please run depot QC and tag infra. Closing until staging uploads. :white_check_mark:
